policy.note: Predeclared before these new comparisons. Beta calibration and annual-refit challengers use only prior training/calibration labels. No tuning on the reused 2024-25 test period; no independent confirmation or market baseline exists. Settlement tasks are hypothetical research contracts, not observed sportsbook tickets.

limitations: Reused 2024-25 project test period, not fresh independent confirmation
Common-sample exclusions can bias results; no test-based tuning/activation
Beta calibration adds a parameter; small calibration samples and binning uncertainty remain
Annual refit uses only prior results but can change calibration transfer; no independent test of stability
UTC-day block intervals do not capture model-search/cross-day dependence
No verified historical odds, operator rules, accepted tickets or profitability
